text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are suffering from severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and dysuria. To determine the cause, can you tell me if the pain is located in the right lower quadrant of your abdomen or if it has moved there?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: PID (Pelvic Inflammatory Disease)

Based on the fever, lower abdominal pain, and the history of sexual activity with inconsistent condom use, I suspect you may have Pelvic Inflammatory Disease. Could you confirm if you have had any vaginal discharge or bleeding between periods?
